title: Approval decision surfaces
description: Objective: implement exact-hash plan, expansion, delta-reapproval, acceptance, confirmation, and cutover decision surfaces. Deliverable: approval modules with reason-coded disabled states. NOT in scope: mutable policy editing or implicit approval. Hard dependencies: Generated control-room client and Policy approval core. Owned paths: apps/control-room/src/approvals/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test.
definitionOfDone: Every decision shows exact subject hash, scope, risk, budget, policy, delta, and consequences.
Disabled actions expose stable reason codes and no stale approval can submit.
Manual default and audited default-off automation are represented accurately.
taskRails: The standalone control room displays daemon truth and nextAllowedCommands; it never derives authority, readiness, or evidence strength.
Every fact is text/icon/color encoded, keyboard accessible, provenance-drillable, and honest under degraded data.
IDE adapters remain thin optional launch/discover/embed shells with no product logic. Keep modules below 400 lines; explicit owned paths only.

implementationPlan.description: DEPENDENCY GATE + baseline. Task B (task-04673fd0, WORKING) commits apps/control-room/src/approvals/approval-j1.tsx among exactly 10 paths — gate: `git log --diff-filter=A -- apps/control-room/src/approvals/approval-j1.tsx` non-empty (file committed) OR Task B DONE; absent -> moe.report_blocked needsFrom task-04673fd0. approval-j1.tsx is NEVER renamed, deleted, or edited — this task extends with NEW sibling files, keeps j1's plan+acceptance slice mounted so Task B's j1-flow test stays green, and its file does NOT count against this task's budget. Baseline reads: apps/control-room/src/kernel.tsx (TruthChip/Fact — never reimplement), src/fixtures.ts (CONTROL_ROOM_FIXTURE_KIND marker + FixtureAffordanceSnapshot — NOTE: it has NO reason channel; the reason channel is approvals-LOCAL, see step 2), packages/core/src/policy/approval-contract.ts:43-62 (ApprovalDecisionRecord field list to mirror STRUCTURALLY — control-room cannot import @moe/core; enums do NOT need mirroring: APPROVAL/APPROVAL_DECISION/APPROVAL_VALIDITY/CUTOVER/TRUTH_CLASS all come from @moe/contracts RUNTIME_LIFECYCLES already in deps). Fresh `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test` GREEN baseline.

TDD red — approval-gating.test.tsx + the fixtures/gating modules it drives. approval-fixtures.ts: DEVELOPMENT_ONLY structural mirror of ApprovalDecisionRecord (exactRevisionHash, riskTier, actor, actorKind HUMAN|SYSTEM_POLICY, decision, decisionReason, lifecycle, validity, approvedNodeScope[], applicablePolicyRef, budgetRef, criteriaRef, planQualityAssessmentRef, policyDecisionRef, stepUpAuthRef, dependencyChanges{additions,challenges,removals}, truthClass) + per-kind decision fixtures (plan, expansion, acceptance, revocation-confirmation, cutover-quiesce, cutover-activate, escalation, reconciliation, soft-policy-waiver as a fixture-typed union member ONLY — no surface) + the design-1007 cutover consequence-payload shape {exactStoredHash, disposition, fundingReservation, planningFenceMembership, deadline, releaseAction, consequencePayload} + the approvals-LOCAL reason-code channel: reasons reuse RATIFIED RuntimeErrorCode spellings whose validSources include APPROVAL/CUTOVER (CAPABILITY_DENIED, STALE_EPOCH, EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT, ILLEGAL_TRANSITION, SUPERSEDED_AUTHORITY, REVISION_REBOUND) + structural mirrors of core CARRY_FORWARD_* for delta display — never invented codes, all marked provisional pending spec §13-D2 (spec 755), carrying the DEVELOPMENT_ONLY marker. approval-gating.ts (PURE): kind+hash affordance matching (decide controls derive ONLY from nextAllowedCommands entries — spec 742 bar 4); STALE-APPROVAL GUARD (DoD 2): an enabled decide control is REFUSED whenever record validity !== CURRENT or exactRevisionHash mismatches the affordance's pinned graphRevisionHash/expectedVersion (design 1007: prepare commits BEFORE the approval action enables — the click never approves an identity created after it); reason-coded-disabled vs ABSENT resolution (spec 588-590: daemon-shaped fixture reason -> disabled 'Unavailable: {phrase} ({CODE})'; NO reason -> control ABSENT, never guessed text). Tests assert exact codes + which guard refused; mutation red-checks named (disable the validity guard -> stale test red; disable the hash match -> mismatch test red). Confirm RED.

TDD red then green — approval-inbox.tsx + approval-inbox.test.tsx (spec §4.6 + §2.6/§8.10). Inbox list: pending items with risk tier, age, precondition summary, [Open], per-item IDLE-CONSEQUENCE line using the §8.10 EXACT strings; ESCALATION and RECONCILIATION render as inbox ITEMS (spec 121/123: cr.approvals.item.escalation; CR-J4-002: third rejection yields the escalation item, not a fourth loop) with idle lines ('node stays parked in PLANNING' / 'the record stays quarantined and unschedulable') and choices rendered ONLY as returned affordance commands (escalation command kinds are ⟨TD⟩ — spec 537 — so fixture affordances supply them; NO full detail surfaces for these kinds); the collapsed cr.approvals.auto group: 'Decided by policy (n) — auto-approved under rev {q} (project opted in)' with per-record 'decided by policy {rev}, rule {rule}' + POL chip (cr.chip.policy-approved via the kernel) + provenance link — and EMPTY/ABSENT under the default-off fixture (manual-default representation, DoD 3: the two spec devices — the auto group + policy-surface mode line — NOT an invented per-kind badge; auto records carry actorKind SYSTEM_POLICY + truthClass DAEMON_VERIFIED never HUMAN_APPROVED, tier R0/R1 only, design 701/710); Approvals empty state 'Nothing needs you.' + degraded 'may be stale' flag (spec 702); badge as polite live region + 'a' shortcut reachability (spec 687/691).

TDD red then green — the per-kind detail surfaces (each <=250) + approval-details.test.tsx. approval-detail-plan.tsx (§4.7): objective, write scope, oracle + recipe-valid check, numbered steps (scrollable; scope/oracle header pinned), abbreviated revision hash, risk tier, idle line, [Approve plan]/[Reject plan…] via cr.action.approval-decide.*; PLUS the §8.4 DELTA-REAPPROVAL variant as a MODE of this surface: invalidation banner ('Your approval of {old} was invalidated by {new} — reviewing only the delta'), both revision hashes named, unchanged nodes collapsed by default under cr.approvals.delta.unchanged (CR-J4-001), INVALIDATED records struck-through + cr.banner.invalidated; §8.11 reject modal with the reopen-bound counter on decline. approval-detail-expansion.tsx (§4.8): subgraph preview, daemon-checked precondition rows cr.approvals.precondition.{scopes|oracles|budget|width} with REAL path sets, budget reservation figure, width/depth vs caps, 'Invalidates:' line, supersedes-hash header — approve control routed via cr.action.graph-approve (NOT approval-decide; spec 307-325, the §13-D1 kind-routing note documented as provisional). approval-detail-acceptance.tsx (§4.9): diff base->head SHAs + file count + in-scope claim, receipt (recipe, exit, time, digest), reviewer identity + distinct-principal check + findings count, [Accept work]/[Decline acceptance…] BOTH via approval.decide; decline carries the §8.11 modal. approval-detail-confirmation.tsx: revocation confirmation + CUTOVER_QUIESCE + CUTOVER_ACTIVATE as three kinds sharing the §9 destructive-modal pattern + step-up display (stepUpAuthRef) + the design-1007 consequence-payload frame — CUTOVER IS DESIGN-DERIVED PROVISIONAL UI (spec has ZERO cutover text: no testids claimed, module header documents the ⟨TD⟩ status; fields from design 1007 verbatim: exact stored hash, disposition, funding reservation, planning-fence membership/deadline, release action, consequence payload); split cutover into its own file via amendment if 250 breaks (then merge two test files to hold the 10-file budget). approval-details.test.tsx: per-kind field-list assertions (every DoD-1 fact: subject hash, scope, risk, budget, policy, delta, consequences — each rendered through kernel Fact/TruthChip with cr.chip.* descendants), narrow-window rule (spec 431: preconditions above previews, decision buttons pinned), keyboard reachability, R3/cutover step-up display, SYSTEM_POLICY records never render human-approved truth.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Verified by a targeted spec agent before planning; key rulings folded: (1) CUTOVER surfaces have ZERO spec basis (grep = 0 hits) — rendered as design-derived PROVISIONAL UI from design 1007's exact field list under the §9 destructive-modal + step-up pattern, never claiming spec testids; (2) the DoD's 'reason-coded disabled states' vs spec 588-590's no-guessed-text rule resolves via an approvals-LOCAL DEVELOPMENT_ONLY reason channel (the landed shared fixtures.ts has NO reason channel — Task B's notes misdescribe it) reusing RATIFIED RuntimeErrorCode spellings with APPROVAL/CUTOVER sources + mirrored CARRY_FORWARD_* codes, provisional pending §13-D2; (3) escalation + reconciliation are INBOX ITEMS with §8.10 idle lines and affordance-only choices (spec 121/123/537/CR-J4-002) — full detail surfaces would be unspecified UI; soft-policy waiver stays a fixture union member only; (4) delta-reapproval is a MODE of the plan detail (§8.4 banner + cr.approvals.delta.unchanged), not a separate surface; (5) expansion approval routes via cr.action.graph-approve, not approval-decide (§4.8; §13-D1 routing note documented provisional); (6) manual-default/audited-automation = the two spec devices exactly (collapsed cr.approvals.auto group + POL chip records, EMPTY under the default-off fixture) — an invented per-kind badge would be unspecified; (7) sibling coordination: extend BESIDE approval-j1.tsx (never touch it), gate on its commit, keep j1-flow green.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: ApprovalDecisionRecord lives in packages/core/src/policy/approval-contract.ts:43-62 (NOT policy-contract.ts) — mirrored structurally (control-room deps exclude @moe/core); enums come from @moe/contracts RUNTIME_LIFECYCLES already in deps (approval/decision/validity/cutover/truth). Stale-approval mechanics assembled: validity leaves CURRENT (INVALIDATED via impact-set, SUPERSEDED via successor) or exactRevisionHash mismatches the affordance's pinned graphRevisionHash/expectedVersion; spec renders INVALIDATED struck-through + cr.banner.invalidated; 'no stale approval can submit' = decide controls derive only from nextAllowedCommands (bar 4) + the gating guard refusing non-CURRENT/hash-mismatched records (design 1007 prepare-before-enable). Per-kind field lists + testids pinned from spec §4.6-4.9, §8.4/8.10/8.11, 431 narrow rule, 687/691 a11y, 702 empty/degraded. Landed kernel TruthChip/Fact reused for every DoD-1 fact (cr.chip.* descendants). Fixture tripwires: no scheduler path literals in strings (root boundary scan covers .tsx).
planningNotes.risks: (1) Stale-submit is the DoD-2 make-or-break — validity + hash guards with mutation red-checks. (2) Guessed disabled-text is the spec's explicit prohibition — reason channel only, absent otherwise, red-checked. (3) Cutover provisional status must be unmistakable in the module header or QA reads it as spec-noncompliant invention. (4) Task B in flight in the same directory — gate on approval-j1.tsx committed; never edit it; j1-flow test green alongside. (5) Kind-routing (§13-D1 unratified): expansion via graph-approve documented provisional. (6) 250-pressure on approval-detail-confirmation (three kinds + 1007 fields) — amendment split point named with the test-merge fallback holding the 10-file budget. (7) Root-gate tripwires on .tsx fixture strings.
